subject: Re: POC trial plan & model selection for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: POC kickoff call / next steps

Thanks for the time today, Aisha — good kickoff. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we have alignment before we lock the POC timeline.

Call summary:
- Goal: 3-week POC to validate retrieval-augmented generation for Acme Analytics’ internal knowledge base (support articles + product docs) with Spanish + Portuguese support.
- Primary success criteria (discussed): 1) >= 85% helpfulness on a randomized eval set (annotator-rated), 2) latency < 800ms p95 for 1-2 concurrent users, 3) false-positive rate on hallucinatory answers < 5% on targeted prompts.
- Data: You’ll provide a 10k-document export (support articles + FAQ) and 50 synthetic evaluation prompts per language.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (alignment): exchange artifacts (data export, security questionnaire), pick model family and fallback, confirm eval rubric.
2) Week 1 (ingest + baseline): ingest KB, run baseline embeddings + BM25, run initial model tests.
3) Week 2 (tuning + eval): experiment with reranking, prompt templates, model variants, collect annotator ratings.
4) Week 3 (final eval + handoff): final metrics, handoff doc and recommendations.

Model selection notes (we discussed options on call):
- Primary candidate: Llama-2-Chat-70B (quantized) — high-quality responses for instruction-following tasks, good multi-turn coherence.
- Fallback candidate: Llama-2-Chat-13B (faster, lower cost) — used if latency/cost targets not met under your concurrency profile.
- Embeddings/multilingual: we recommend using a multilingual embedding model (e.g., M2M-100 or an open multilingual embedder) for retrieval across Spanish/Portuguese + English.

Action items / owners:
- Aisha (Acme): share data export + 50 eval prompts per language, return signed DPA if needed (we attached the security questionnaire).
- Ben (Redwood): share POC plan spreadsheet and estimated infra/config; provision trial capacity and spin up baseline models.
- Marissa (Customer Success): coordinate access, annotator instructions, and scoring template.

Attachments: poc-scope.pdf (call notes), security-questionnaire.pdf

Next steps: If this looks good I’ll send a formal POC plan (spreadsheet) with schedule and test owners — aiming to start Week 0 on Monday 2026-07-27 if you can deliver the data by 2026-07-24.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123


From: Aisha Gupta <aisha@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: POC kickoff call / next steps

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: Agreed on the three main metrics. We’ll also add an operational criterion: no PII leakage in >99% of sampled responses (we’ll supply a list of sensitive tokens for testing).
2) Multilingual: Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese are must-haves — the team will provide eval prompts in en/es/pt-BR. We strongly prefer a model with demonstrated Spanish/Portuguese capability.
3) Model preference: we like Llama-2-Chat-70B for quality but worried about cost. If Redwood can run the initial baseline on the 70B for Week 1 and then fall back to 13B for load tests, that works.

Deliverables from Acme by 2026-07-24: 10k-doc export (S3 link coming), 50 eval prompts per language, list of sensitive tokens, and sign-off on the DPA (Daniel is looping legal).

A couple questions: can Redwood provide an expected cost range for running the 70B baseline for 1 week? And can you confirm whether embeddings will be generated with a multilingual open model (we prefer not to use a proprietary embedder for reproducibility)?

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Product | Acme Analytics

Subject: Re: Recap: POC kickoff call / next steps (POC plan attached)

Great — thanks for the commitments, Aisha. Attached is the detailed POC plan (poc-plan.xlsx) with timeline, owner matrix, test buckets, and an estimated cost envelope. High-level answers below: 

Cost estimate for 70B baseline (Week 1):
- Baseline run (5 x 2-hour test windows to collect samples across prompts): ~18 GPU-hours on A100-equivalent. Estimated infra cost (on Redwood Dedicated trial pricing): $2.3k - $3.2k for baseline depending on quantization and batching. If we use an int8 quantized runtime, cost skews toward the lower end.

Embeddings choice:
- We will generate multilingual embeddings using an open multilingual embedder (we recommend M2M-100-derived embeddings or an open multilingual encoder) so results are reproducible on-prem. We will not use proprietary closed embeddings unless you request it.

Model selection & fallback policy (detailed):
- Primary: Llama-2-Chat-70B (int8 quantized) — used for qualitative checks and the annotator-rated eval in Week 1.
- Fallback: Llama-2-Chat-13B (int8) — used for stress/load tests and cost-constrained scenarios.
- If Spanish/Portuguese quality is insufficient on the 70B baseline, we’ll try Falcon-40B-Instruct as an alternate candidate (we’ve seen good multilingual behavior on customer KB tasks).

Evaluation plan (what we’ll measure):
- Annotator-rated helpfulness (1-5) across 150 sampled queries (50 per language). Target >= 85% rated >=4.
- Latency p95 under representative routing: < 800ms for the 13B fallback; < 1200ms p95 for 70B baseline (we’ll report both).
- Hallucination/factuality: sample-based precision against ground-truth answers; target <= 5% hallucination rate.
- PII leakage: run synthetic sensitive tokens test provided by Acme; target <= 1% leakage.

Ownership & contacts:
- Ben (Redwood): POC infra + model configs (primary).
- Marissa (Redwood CS): annotator instructions, scoring sheet owner.
- Aisha / Daniel (Acme): data owner, legal for DPA.

Next steps (concrete):
1) Aisha: send S3 link and eval prompts by 2026-07-24 (Daniel to confirm DPA).
2) Ben: create Redwood trial project and share credentials + poc-plan.xlsx by EOD 2026-07-20.
3) Marissa: prepare annotator instructions and scoring template by 2026-07-22.

I’ve attached the poc-plan.xlsx and included the security questionnaire we discussed. If you want us to prioritize Falcon-40B-Instruct as the initial candidate instead of Llama-2-Chat-70B so you can avoid the 70B baseline cost, we can flip that — tell us your preference and we’ll adjust the schedule/estimate.

Best,
Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
